thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: sudden spike in 5xx for /v1/generate, upstream gateway timeouts. Alerting oncall.
eli_oncall: I'm up. seeing 502 spikes from gateway, ~30% error rate p95 latency up. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/ops/kv-prefix (shortlink).
anya_sre: can you paste the stacktrace/logs? quick suspicion: prefix-kv reads failing under fanout.
matt_eng: logs show lots of `checksum mismatch` errors from prefix-shard-7 when validating prefix index. sample: ```ERROR prefix_shard.cpp:279 checksum mismatch expected=0x8a3b got=0x0ff3 ctx=request=<req id=abc123>```
eli_oncall: also seeing an uptick in cache-refresh heartbeats failing between nodes in region-us-east-1. heartbeats show 503 on /hb endpoints for a subset of pod IPs.
sara_support: we have 2 customers reporting user-facing failures (inference requests), CS ticket #13421 attached. they report recurring 502s starting ~09:42Z.
jun_ml: config: we rolled the prefix-kv sidecar image last night (v2.7.1 -> v2.8.0) with a checksum change in the new wal serializer. could be related.
eli_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) enable bypass-read fallback to persistent store for affected prefixes 2) reduce read fanout threshold 3) temporarily scale up prefix-shard replicas 4) if needed, rollback sidecar image. I'm going to run the bypass.
anya_sre: +1. add a circuit-breaker for prefix shard reads to fail fast to persistent store to avoid gateway timeouts.
matt_eng: command to toggle bypass: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.internal/kv/control/bypass -d '{"shard":7,"enable":true,"reason":"live-mitigate-checksum"}'```
eli_oncall: ran the bypass for shard 7 at 09:55Z. monitoring: error rate dropped from 30% -> 12% within 90s but p95 still high.
sara_support: telling customers we're mitigating and will follow up. ticket updated. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
jun_ml: checking telemetry: checksum mismatch counter increased sharply at 09:40Z coinciding with new sidecar rollout windows. shard 7 peers had divergent local checksum tables.
anya_sre: can we force resync for shard 7 rather than full rollback? a resync would repair the on-disk index without impacting other shards.
matt_eng: yes, we have a repair job: `kv-tool resync --shard 7 --mode=incremental` will attempt to rebuild prefix index from SSTs. cost: brief increased IO, should be safe behind bypass. scheduling now.
eli_oncall: kicking resync at 10:02Z. will keep bypass on.
(ops-bot automated): Pager escalated to SRE layer for 30s: @anya_sre paged.
anya_sre: monitoring resync logs: ```Resync shard=7 start ts=1700000002 reading sst 12..18 progress 0/100```
eli_oncall: network heartbeats improving after a kube node restart in the pool — coworker restarted the failing node to restore /hb. ops changed node via `kubectl drain`. that likely helped connectivity to a replica.
sara_support: customers saw some improvement around 10:05Z, but one enterprise customer still sees intermittent 502s. I'm escalating for SLA note.
jun_ml: resync halfway through, parity checks now passing for many prefixes. checksum mismatch counter decreasing.
matt_eng: small risk: resync will touch the KV write throttle. prepared to pause if we see write latency regress.
eli_oncall: write throttle nominal. resync completed at 10:14Z. after resync and bypass removal (performed 10:16Z), error rate down to ~1.5% and latencies back near baseline.
anya_sre: rolling verification: re-enabled prefetch at lower fanout threshold 4 -> 2 to avoid large read storms. will revert after confidence window.
sara_support: updated customers, ticket #13421 marked as 'mitigated, postmortem pending'. one request for timeline for root cause.
jun_ml: root cause hypothesis: image v2.8.0 introduced a subtle serializer change combined with a small subset of shards that still had old-format SSTs. under heavy fanout, the mismatch surfaced as checksum validation failures and triggered read cascades/timeouts.
matt_eng: follow-ups: 1) patch sidecar to validate format compatibility on startup and refuse to join cluster (fail fast) 2) add preflight check during rollouts to validate checksum parity 3) improve observability: histogram for checksum-validator latencies and mismatch tags 4) run a sweep job to revalidate all shard checksums proactively. owners: matt_eng + jun_ml.
eli_oncall: I'm leaving a handoff note: oncall -> anya_sre for next 8h to watch rollback window and deployment flaps.
anya_sre: taking handoff. I'll watch the dashboards and keep CS looped. tagging postmortem owners.
ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Incident ID INC-2026-4023.
sara_support: customer impact summary to include: affected endpoints /v1/generate -> 09:40Z-10:16Z, peak 30% 5xx, major customers A & B experienced retries/failures; no data loss, consistent with transient read-only checksum mismatch.
eli_oncall: saved logs to /incidents/4023456789/artifacts.tar.gz and flagged the failing sidecar image in the image registry.
anya_sre: quick checklist for postmortem: timeline + root cause + rollout preflight + resync runbook + communications template. I'll draft and share in #postmortems.
matt_eng: I'll prepare the patch and a canary rollout plan with preflight. expected PR by EOD.
sara_support: thanks everyone. closing chat for now, will add to postmortem thread. :thumbsup:
